# Nomadigit brand

> Brand kit for Nomadigit projects (sites, Telegram bots and Mini Apps, apps, slides, CV, images). Petrol #04556D primary, signal red #FC5950 accent (one focal point only), one typeface (Onest) plus Geist Mono for code, light and dark themes. Never hardcode values; read them from the generated files below.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/AGENTS.md): rules, brand architecture, what to read for each task, done checklist
- [tokens/brand.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/tokens/brand.json): the source of truth for every value

## Generated files

- [dist/tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/dist/tokens.css): CSS variables, light + dark
- [dist/brand.css](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Nomadigit/brand@main/dist/brand.css): fonts + tokens + base styles (CDN)
- [dist/tokens.flat.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/dist/tokens.flat.json): flat key/value tokens
- [dist/tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/dist/tokens.json): W3C design tokens
- [dist/tailwind.preset.cjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/dist/tailwind.preset.cjs): Tailwind preset
- [dist/marp-theme.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/dist/marp-theme.css): slide theme
- [assets/logo/lockup-horizontal.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/assets/logo/lockup-horizontal.svg): default logo

## Optional

- [docs/api.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nomadigit/brand/main/docs/api.md): TypeScript API for the transformers
